lines.differs: Same as PayTrack Technologies: both require payment within 30 days of invoice.
Same as Sunrise Foods: both require payment within 30 days of invoice.
Better for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: payment is due within 30 days instead of 45 days.
Worse for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: confidentiality survives indefinitely for claimant personal information, not just trade secrets.
Worse for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: confidentiality survives for 3 years instead of 2, plus indefinitely for trade secrets and personal data.
Better for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: confidentiality obligations expire after 3 years for general information rather than remaining perpetual.
Better for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: the client's licence to pre-existing tools is restricted to internal purposes.
Worse for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: explicitly grants the client a perpetual, royalty-free licence to incorporated pre-existing tools.
Better for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: the client's licence to pre-existing materials is limited to internal purposes.
Same as Acme Retail Group: both provide mutual indemnification for confidentiality, IP infringement, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
Same as Sunrise Foods: both provide mutual indemnification for confidentiality, IP infringement, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
Better for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: intellectual property infringement indemnification is mutual rather than required only from AtliQ.
Worse for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: liability for confidentiality and indemnification is uncapped rather than subject to the overall fee cap.
Worse for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: indemnification obligations are excluded from the liability cap in addition to confidentiality.
Worse for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: liability for indemnification and confidentiality is uncapped rather than subject to the cap.
Same as Acme Retail Group: delay penalty of 0.5% per week is capped at 5% of the milestone fee, excluding client delays.
Better for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: delay penalty is 0.5% per week capped at 5% instead of 1%.
Better for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: penalty is 0.5% per week capped at 5% of milestone fee, excluding client delays.
Better for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: incident notification deadline is 72 hours instead of 24 hours.
Better for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: does not require prior written approval for accessing data outside the United States.
Better for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: incident notification deadline is 72 hours instead of 6 hours, without data residency restrictions.
